description: List what a scheduled report's layout can be made of: the presets (executive summary, spend by service, AI spend, budgets and anomalies), and the dashboard widgets that can be rendered into a report — each with the cost-scope types it supports — plus the dashboard widgets that cannot be (charts and heatmaps have no report form) and why. Use the `catalog_id`s with create_scheduled_report / update_scheduled_report's `layout`. Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/report-layouts.
name: list_report_layouts
